name: EdgeLight
tagline: Two pixels of build status. We'd apologise for the excess, but there isn't any.
description: Other clients get cars, swords and explosions. This one gets a line. One to five pixels along any edge of your screen, green while everything passes, amber while a pull request sulks, breathing gently while a build runs. No window, no clicks, no desk space, no personality. You'll forget it's there, which is the point. Only a broken build earns a little drama: an old rotating hazard light slides out of the edge and spins until someone fixes it. Too much? Switch it off and enjoy your line.
